content.text:
Updated the package and README to match all ten sections of `SPEC.md`. The audit also found and fixed three issues beyond the named work items: group rankings now exclude empty groups and break ties by name, per-group rates are returned in name order with `None` for empty groups, and flag streaks reset on nonpositive counts.

Added regression tests for `None` remaining in the flag-rate denominator and for the last input record winning when transcript IDs repeat, even if it has an earlier day.

Ran `python -m pytest -q`, exercising every specified function: **21 tests passed**.
